sources.title: AURA-Net: Rapid and Accurate Corpus Callosum Segmentation
sources.snippet: This project presents AURA-Net, a novel deep learning approach for segmenting the corpus callosum (CC) in brain MRI images. We developed a custom U-Net-based architecture that integrates Residual blocks, Attention gates, Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP), and Deep Supervision.
